notes.title: Update #4
notes.notes:
This is the biggest game update yet, players can build entire settlements and there is a new city on the map !


 Entire settlements can be created in build mode
 New big city on the map
 Added animations for player zoom mode
 Improved player inventory UI
 Improved camera wall clip mechanic
 Added more props models
 Improved some building textures
 Buildings interiors are more detailed
 Added new trees models

 Added new building

 Player starts with assault rifle
 Added furniture to buildings interiors
 Player inventory UI rework
 Player customization fix

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
Our first game update is live, you can see your position on the minimap and lots of other improvements !


 Added minimap on key 'm"
 Added sounds for eat, jump, drink, robot detector
 New sounds for weapons
 Improved robot behaviour
 Fixed some broken buildings shadows
 Fixed getting stuck in customisation scene
 Fixed loot items disappearing when dragged
 Fixed reloading with no ammo
 Loot rebalance
